item.title: Notes from the Field: Molecular Detections of Cladophialophora bantiana at a Clinical Reference Laboratory - United States, 2009-2026
item.description: This report describes 48 confirmed cases and one probable case of C. bantiana in clinical samples from 2009-2026.

item.title: Effectiveness of Diphtheria and Tetanus Toxoids and Acellular Pertussis Vaccine in Children Aged 6 Months-6 Years During a Statewide Pertussis Outbreak - Alaska, May-November 2024
item.description: This report describes effectiveness of the diphtheria and tetanus toxoids and acellular pertussis vaccination series during a statewide pertussis outbreak in Alaska during 2024.

item.title: Notes from the Field: Dengue Outbreak - U.S. Virgin Islands, January 2024-June 2025
item.description: This report describes the response to a dengue virus outbreak in the U.S. Virgin Islands during 2024-2025.

item.title: QuickStats: Age-Adjusted Female Breast Cancer Death Rates, by State - United States, 2024
item.description: This report describes age-adjusted female breast cancer death rates in the U.S. during 2024.

item.title: Supplements: Urban-Rural and Demographic Differences in Substance Use Among High School Students - Youth Risk Behavior Survey, United States, 2025
item.description: This report describes patterns of substance use among U.S. high school students and examines differences by sex, race and ethnicity, grade, and urban-rural classification.

item.title: Supplements: Prevalence of Binge Eating Behavior Among High School Students and Associations with Social Media Use, Mental Health, and Suicide Risk - Youth Risk Behavior Survey, United States, 2025
item.description: This report describes the prevalence of binge eating among U.S. high school students, identifies disproportionately affected groups, and examines associations between binge eating and social media use, mental health, and suicide risk.

item.title: Supplements: Unmet Need for Mental Health Services Among High School Students Experiencing Persistent Feelings of Sadness or Hopelessness - Youth Risk Behavior Survey, United States, 2025
item.description: This report describes the first nationally representative estimates of mental health service use among U.S. adolescents experiencing persistent feelings of sadness or hopelessness.

item.title: Supplements: Cardiovascular Health Among High School Students - Youth Risk Behavior Survey, United States, 2025
item.description: This report describes estimates of five cardiovascular health (CVH) metrics (diet, physical activity, nicotine exposure, sleep health, and BMI) among U.S. high school students.

item.title: Supplements: Dietary and Physical Activity Behaviors Among High School Students - Youth Risk Behavior Survey, United States, 2025
item.description: This report describes 2025 estimates of dietary and physical activity behaviors among adolescents overall and by sex, race and ethnicity, and grade level during 2025.
